purpose: Portable archival data from one completed developer resize calibration; not raw report or production authority. Independent saved-output audit remains a separate release criterion.
transform: Only exact known proof/project/runtime-build root strings replaced with logical aliases. No other key/type/value changed; private inverse mapping excluded.
diagnosticLimit: All 42 retained child stderr captures were locally hash/length checked: 39 empty and three successful targets of 499 bytes each with duplicate-codec and x265 CPU-mask/thread-pool diagnostics. Complete capture is not warning-free execution.
limitations: No runtime binaries, media, spools, raw child-log files, private root mapping or approvals included.
Only three finite resize cases on two generated sources; no arbitrary geometry/duration, video-pixel identity or visual-quality claim.
Calibration is not normal-service publication/cancellation, native integration, production catalog/default activation or owner acceptance.
Output/media audit uses retained evidence and hashes, not fresh independent media decoding; audit record separately defines its actual outcome.
Outer ISO and raw epoch clock domains must not be assumed synchronized; source budgets are not measured hardware throughput or hard OS caps.
Full output hashes were first established by the independent saved-output audit, not compared against an earlier full-output baseline.
Full output probe JSON is not separately retained; geometry/SAR/clock acceptance relies on executed reviewed harness assertions, saved validation and frame checks, not a fresh independent ffprobe.
Returned/persisted post-close report equality was enforced by the executed launcher; there are not two independently saved full report objects.

report.boundsClassification: preregistered-clock-derived-acceptance-bounds; measured only by this campaign, never automatic catalog authority

derivation.video: source video tick + fixed output tick + one microsecond representation allowance
derivation.audioInterior: source audio tick + one source sample + fixed output tick
derivation.audioEndpoint: audio interior quantization only; FLAC adds no coding tail
derivation.containerDuration: end-timestamp: max decoded video/audio output end; duration bound = video bound + ceil(one sample)
derivation.sampleCount: zero: complete selected canonical s16le PCM byte/hash/sample identity
